certificate.completeness_claim: all candidate class counts N=0,...,6 are checked; every N>=7 is also impossible because N*r is increasing
certificate.scope_warning: The arithmetic certificate verifies the counting consequence of the cited conditional shell lemmas; it does not independently prove those graph-theoretic lemmas or close the d1 terminal.

constraints.formula: t_s >= r for each distinct d1 shell class

promotion_policy.reason: this proves a shell-class count bound only; bounded-allowance d1 nonextension remains open

sources.theorem: Under A+B and r>=12, every d1 missing partner has t_s>=r and sum_A t_s<=6r-2; therefore at most five d1 shell classes exist

instance.statement: Assuming the conditional shell-incidence lemmas from the cited endpoint theorem, each distinct d1 missing-partner shell vertex contributes at least r to the incidence sum, while the total is at most 6r-2. Therefore N*r<=6r-2 and N<=5 for r>=12.
